goal: Build one refined, connected stock-trading application that can rival TradingView and thinkorswim. The autonomous agents choose and evolve its architecture and priorities.
architecture_reasoning: Adopt supplied dataset preparation as the first connected research workspace: existing inspection produces exact rows, preparation records identity and provenance, chart and Core validation consume the same dataset. Utilities remain independent and do not generate strategy results.

components.name: Current product page
components.responsibility: Dataset chart, exact-value table, eligibility and separate report/Core downloads; legacy utilities retained

components.name: OHLCV CSV inspector
components.responsibility: Inspect user-supplied CSV; its output is not canonical research data

components.name: Cost sensitivity calculator
components.responsibility: Analyze manually entered hypothetical trade costs

components.name: Submitted trade CSV analyzer
components.responsibility: Analyze externally supplied records; does not generate or execute trades

components.name: Core research contracts and engine
components.responsibility: Shared validation and computation; pure product SDK is available without host storage or credentials

components.name: Triad research adapter
components.responsibility: Owner-scoped Core frame validation and reusable research execution adapter; UI executes no experiments

components.name: Supplied dataset preparation
components.responsibility: Bounded metadata and CSV to traceable chart rows and separately validated Core input

workflows.user_outcome: Research and test a trading idea through one coherent workspace with traceable results
workflows.next_connection: Agents should choose and establish the application backbone and a first useful connected workflow using proven Core interfaces. Identify required concepts, contracts and dependencies; do not assume unrelated CSV tools already integrate.

workflows.user_outcome: Supply bars and provenance, chart observed values, understand Core eligibility, export traceable input
workflows.next_connection: Establish product Strategy callback contract and connect eligible datasets to experiments with explicit costs and execution assumptions; then link result charts and ledger review through a versioned result contract.

decisions: 2026-10-03 operator correction: the application itself is the product. product.html and disconnected calculators are prototypes, not completion of the mission.

Triad and Aegis independently consume Core. Triad chooses its own design and builds missing product tools and spaces. No Aegis dependency, broker credential grant, or live-trading authority is implied.
Core SDK connection is demonstrated on explicit synthetic fixtures. It does not connect the existing CSV tools, certify real data, supply stored research or create the user-facing trading workflow.
next_initiatives: Dataset-to-experiment connection after product strategy interface is established
Versioned experiment results to chart overlays and performance review

identity_specification.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
identity_specification.decimal_strings: Inspector fixed-point formatting retained, including trailing zeros
identity_specification.raw_digest: SHA-256 of exact submitted CSV UTF-8 including BOM and whitespace
identity_specification.ordering: Rows sorted by UTC timestamp then symbol; equivalent row reorder changes raw digest only

transformations: Rows sorted by timestamp and symbol
SDK Bar converts decimal strings to floats only in Core input; exact strings remain in preparation report
provenance_limits: Caller-supplied source label, timezone, mode, version and ingestion time; source_symbol unchanged
Owner fixed to triad; provenance_id and dataset_id are prepared-content identity
Core assumes XNYS one-minute regular-session USD equities, UNADJUSTED; structural checks do not certify these source attributes
No fabricated provider provenance, repaired gaps, aggregation or dropped rows
Inspector-valid Core-rejected rows remain chartable; Core export requires actual ProductResearch.frame acceptance
remaining_gaps: Product strategy and experiment execution with linked result evaluation
Portfolio construction and ongoing risk monitoring
